newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Aminex says continues to make progress.
newsitem.headline: Aminex says continues to make progress.

text.p: Irish oil and gas development group Aminex Plc said on Tuesday it cut its losses sharply in 1996 and continued to make progress in all operational areas in the year to date.

"In 1996 Aminex made significant progress in all of its operational areas, which has been sustained in 1997. Our Russian and U.S. production provide a sound income stream which has been enhanced by the Vinton acquisition," chief executive Brian Hall said in a statement.
Aminex bought a stake in the Vinton Dome field in Louisiana with effect from January 1 this year. The acquisition included a workover rig and oilfield equipment.
Hall said Aminex's El Biban oilfield development in Tunisia would deliver first oil in September.
Aminex, which is involved in the Russian Komi pipeline, said it was examining other "significant" opportunities in Russia. It gave no further details.
Aminex said it cut its pretax losses in 1996 to $1.15 million from a loss of 2.87 million a year earlier. The loss per share was cut to 2.49 cents from 7.07 previously.
